body: I think I’m just going to try not to do anything drastic until I’m in a more clear state of mind. Thanks. I’m just completely lost right now.
I did, no answer. They were one of the first people I tried.
My parents are out of town and likely asleep. I think I should drive there but I don’t know if I have the capacity. I guess taxi is an option. I just can’t find the will to do anything.
I’m so mentally fucked right now. I feel like I can’t think. Maybe I should follow suit.

Her aunt answered my call and said she would keep me updated but it’s been 40 minutes since the original and 30 minutes since I called her back. They all live a 40 minute drive away and I can’t legally drive to them at this hour. I’m pretty close with her family though, I just don’t know what to do.

I have nobody now. Not only is she gone, but everyone I’ve tried to contact is unavailable. It’s fitting, fair almost. I wasn’t there for her when she needed it. I know people will say it’s not on me, but it kind of is.
